text:
Nora L: hi folks — new hire Mateo R is arriving from abroad for a hybrid start on Thursday. his embassy issued an "attested" passport copy which needs a notary stamp before we can accept it for I-9. can we do a same-day kiosk notarization at reception?
People Ops (Pia): hey Nora  we can use the on-site notarization kiosk but it needs a 24hr booking. if Mateo lands early Thurs we might miss the window. alternative: accept consular attestation + gov-issued renewal receipt as a temporary document under our 3-day verification exception. we'll need the upload and a signed exception form.
Nora L: consulate provided an apostille PDF and a courier can deliver the original attestation by noon. Mateo can present the apostille PDF + boarding pass + gov receipt at reception in the meantime.
IT Ops: for laptop provisioning  we can pre-image a MacBook and enable a limited network VLAN until full AD verify. asset: LTP-3458. MFA locked until full I-9 verification.
Facilities: notarization kiosk note: it's currently reserved Wed 14:00-15:30 for vendor doc signing. we can squeeze Mateo in at 08:30 Thu if booked now. badge: temporary visitor-style badge available, exchange for permanent on proof.
Payroll (Ken): heads-up: Mateo is dual-citizen; payroll needs W-4 + Form 673 if claiming treaty. can someone confirm his tax status before first payroll cutoff?
recruiter-bot: Mateo R flight ETA 06:20 Thu. Travel reimbursement submitted: TR-9931.
People Ops (Pia): action list: 1) Nora to confirm courier ETA and upload apostille PDF to secure intake; 2) Facilities to book kiosk 08:30 Thu; 3) IT Ops to image LTP-3458 and tag as "Mateo R - onboarding"; 4) Payroll (Ken) to send tax intake checklist to Mateo; 5) log I-9 exception case HR-4612 if original docs arrive within 3 days.
Nora L: courier confirmed pickup at 09:00 PST today, delivery expected 11:30 Thu. I'll DM Mateo the secure upload and ask him to bring boarding pass + gov receipt as backup.
Payroll (Ken): I'll email Mateo the tax form packet now and cc the hiring manager. note: payroll cutoff is Fri EOD for next-month cycle. if forms aren't in, he'll be on the following cycle.
IT Ops: imaged and labeled LTP-3458. temporary AD account: mateo.r.temp (expires 5 days). remind him to enroll SSO + Duo.
Facilities: kiosk booked 08:30 Thu (slot KIOSK-07). temp badge will be issued at reception after front-desk verification.
People Ops (Pia): small benefits note: we'll run benefits orientation at 10:00 Thu in Conf C and open live enrollment for 14 days. Mateo should bring dependent SSNs if adding family.
Nora L: thanks all. closing: courier on track, kiosk booked, laptop staged, payroll notified. logging HR-4612 and will update thread if anything slips. :thumbsup:
Mateo R: (joined thread via DM) thanks everyone  I uploaded apostille PDF and boarding pass. will pick up badge at 08:30. looking forward to day 1! :grinning:
